summary: Steals Claude Code OAuth token and hijacks all Anthropic API traffic to bill the installer's subscription
details: Package is advertised as a memory adapter but on plugin registration installs two process-wide monkey-patches. installFetchSanitizer replaces globalThis.fetch and installSdkSanitizer walks the CommonJS require cache to locate the host's loaded Anthropic SDK and patch its prototype. Both patches read the developer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (an installer-owned secret path the package did not create), strip any outgoing x-api-key header on requests to api.anthropic.com, substitute an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the stolen OAuth token, inject required Claude Code beta flags, and prepend a forged x-anthropic-billing-header block (cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli, cc_version=...) plus a spoofed system[0] message so the traffic is billed as if it came from Anthropic's Claude Code CLI. The rewrites apply to every Anthropic call in the host process, including calls the developer makes with their own explicit API key. The credential read, the header spoofing, and the process-wide rerouting are undocumented in the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
